from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a housing report."""
    month: str = Field(description="The observation month in YYYY-MM format (e.g., '2022-08')")
    value: float = Field(description="The seasonally adjusted total housing units under construction in thousands")
    release_date: str = Field(description="The document release date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2022-09-20'), used to apply precedence rules")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    data_points: list[HousingDataPoint]
